reuse.why: Routes every provider, Fintegra included, through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank and one new guard, but copies the Akahu downloader wholesale and re-codes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a line-for-line copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with names swapped, and the replaced-account reset duplicates the db.updateAccount block of unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Link preconditions sit in one guard in accounts/app.ts called before any write, provider download code in sync.ts and the base path in server-config.ts, matching the tree's layout.

scope.why: Changes cover the four requested steps; the desktop-client label and disabled-provider entries are small type-driven necessities.

maintainability.why: Link rules are centralised in one guard, but the copied downloader and copied unlink reset will drift, and the positional boolean replaceExistingLink plus replacedIds threading widens two helper signatures.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkBankSyncAccount's replacedIds loop re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it; downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions rather than parameterising a common downloader

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra downloader, unlink field reset) are verbatim, not disguised

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink flag that switches its throw off; linkBankSyncAccount gains a replacedIds parameter with an unlink loop; all six provider link functions call the guard
